description: Literature search: full-text search across 61,000+ public-domain books (Project Gutenberg corpus). Returns the most relevant complete passages from any book, ranked, with title, author, section and source link. Retrieval only: real cited passages, never LLM-generated text. Costs $0.02 via x402 (requires WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY, USDC on Base).

query.description: Full-text search query, e.g. 'the nature of justice'

name: search_literature
